t: A trade offered in plain terms
a: يَا ابْنَ آدَمَ تَفَرَّغْ لِعِبَادَتِي أَمْلأْ صَدْرَكَ غِنًى وَأَسُدَّ فَقْرَكَ وَإِنْ لَمْ تَفْعَلْ مَلأْتُ صَدْرَكَ شُغْلاً وَلَمْ أَسُدَّ فَقْرَكَ
p: Yā-bna Ādam, tafarragh li-ʿibādatī amlaʾ ṣadraka ghinan wa asudda faqrak. Wa in lam tafʿal malaʾtu ṣadraka shughlan wa lam asudda faqrak
m: Son of Adam, make yourself free for My worship and I will fill your chest with sufficiency and close up your poverty. And if you do not, I will fill your chest with occupation and I will not close up your poverty.
